regime_context: Hong Kong thematic leadership is concentrated in Banks (rank 1, crowded, mean-revert, high breadth), followed by Energy and High-Dividend Blue Chips — but only 5 of 17 themes clear the absolute-trend gate, and the rotation spread is narrowing with no directional handoff. The gate does help on HK history, so trend discipline is worth honoring; still, rank is a focus lens, not a return forecast, and none of the top themes has an ETF proxy to grade against.
emerging_watch: Watching whether Energy (H-shares) can close the rotation margin to Banks (currently 0.215) and challenge for rank 1 while staying eligible — a confirmed handoff would retire this watch; if the margin widens back above 0.4, the watch ends as no handoff.

theses.subject: Banks (H + HK)
theses.thesis: The only theme that is both rank 1 and eligible under the absolute-trend gate, with high breadth (0.846) suggesting the leadership is shared across many constituents rather than a single-name spike. Durability is middling (0.62) and the Hurst tag is mean-revert, so the trend is not self-reinforcing; crowding (z=1.15) is a cap-the-size caution, not a fade.
theses.dissent: Mean-revert Hurst tag plus crowding means this leadership can unwind quickly without new flow; the historical edge on HK is drawdown control, not return, so an overweight here is a bet that the trend persists a few more weeks against reflexivity risk.

falsifier.text: Banks (H + HK) breadth drops below 0.5 or the theme loses eligible status before the 20-day horizon.

check.reason: theme has no scalar etf_proxy → not cleanly scorable

theses.subject: Energy (H-shares)
theses.thesis: Rank 2 and eligible, with the strongest durability_bar (0.71) and a trend Hurst tag — the cleanest trend-health profile in the eligible set. Not crowded, so no sizing caution. The absolute-trend gate is the one validated leg on HK history, and Energy passes it.
theses.dissent: The rotation margin to Banks is thin (0.215) and breadth of rotation is narrowing, meaning Energy is not taking over leadership; a challenger that never confirms can stall alongside the leader and give back relative gains.

falsifier.text: Energy (H-shares) ranks below 3 or loses eligibility before the 20-day horizon.

check.reason: theme has no scalar etf_proxy → not cleanly scorable

theses.subject: High-Dividend Blue Chips
theses.thesis: Rank 3 and eligible with decent breadth (0.75) and no crowding. In a regime where only five themes clear the trend gate, the defensible posture is to stay with gate-eligible themes and avoid the ineligible majority; High-Dividend is the third of those five and has a mixed Hurst tag, so the trend is not confirmed but the gate says it has not broken down.
theses.dissent: Mixed Hurst tag means no directional persistence signal, and the theme is not challenging for leadership; an overweight may be dead money rather than a trend continuation.

falsifier.text: High-Dividend Blue Chips loses eligible status or durability_bar drops below 0.5 before the 20-day horizon.
